subject.title: feat: cross-gateway sessions_send and sessions_spawn via gateway.peers

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a cross-gateway session-tool surface now, and if so must it be limited to configured authenticated peers instead of raw model-supplied gateway URLs?
rationale: The PR is a feature/config/security-boundary change, not only a mechanical bug fix, and current related issues still split between a concrete session-routing need and a broader federation trust model.

options.title: Approve peer-only contract after repair
options.body: Keep the work in core only if the PR is narrowed to configured peers with explicit auth, fixes the protocol defects, and adds live multi-gateway proof.

options.title: Defer to federation FRD
options.body: Pause or close this implementation until the broader bridge identity, scopes, and replay contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87733 is decided.

options.title: Route to external bridge first
options.body: Keep core gateway-local and ask for a plugin or bridge implementation unless a missing core API seam is identified.

recommendation.title: Approve peer-only contract after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the work in core only if the PR is narrowed to configured peers with explicit auth, fixes the protocol defects, and adds live multi-gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans session-tool architecture, gateway URL security, and public docs/product framing where steipete has recent adjacent history.
